arguments.sql: SELECT a.address_id, a.line_1, a.line_2 FROM Addresses a JOIN (SELECT address_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT current_address_id AS address_id FROM Students UNION ALL SELECT permanent_address_id FROM Students) GROUP BY address_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) sub ON a.address_id = sub.address_id
